Subject: Sequencing and acceptance milestones for Helios pilot (MSA / DPA / Order flow)

Alex / Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. Per our conversation I put together a short execution lanes doc (attached) that sequences evaluation milestones, legal gating, and the order/PO timeline so we can land on a target signature date. High-level asks in the MAP:

- Evaluation acceptance (technical sign-off): target 2026-06-15
- DPA review and redline window: complete by 2026-06-03
- MSA signature and Order Form executed: target 2026-06-25 — allows a two-week procurement/PO window after MSA
- Production onramp & onboarding: week of 2026-07-06

Who owns what: I marked owners in the attached spreadsheet, but quick calls: Helios provides security questionnaire responses + procurement PO intent; Redwood delivers redlined DPA back to Helios (Laura/Karthik). If procurement needs a shorter window, tell us now and we’ll compress the DPA/QA window.

Attachments: 20260522-Helios-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners) and Helios-OrderForm-draft.pdf (initial pricing/order form).

Next step: can you confirm by EOD Monday (2026-05-25) whether the proposed acceptance date (6/15) and signature target (6/25) are workable for your internal approvals? If procurement needs a PO by 6/10 instead we should shift the DPA turnaround earlier.

Best,
Ben
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Ben — thanks for the clear plan and the MAP. We like the structure. A few notes from our side:

1) Procurement window: Finance needs a PO by 2026-06-10 to make our June month cut-off. If the MSA is signed 6/25 that's past the window. Can we aim for Order Form execution (or at least a signed MSA + PO) by 6/10?

2) DPA: our security team has a few non-negotiables: data retention 90 days default, a clear deletion mechanism, and EU data-subset residency options. We will send a short list of required DPA clauses by EOD 5/25.

3) Evaluation: technical acceptance by 6/15 is fine as long as there is a short testing acceptance checklist (we can share).

We can do a 30-minute sync on 5/26 to align owners if helpful.
